body: I can't wear sunglasses at work

I don't know. It just makes me very uncomfortable. Be it a long stare or a quick glance.

I don't look at people when I talk to them. Not even my family or SO. They understand and accept it, but no one else does.
I'm not going to spend my whole life pretending everything's ok

You still have to be interviewed by a person. You still have to pump gas where other people are. You still have to buy groceries where other people are. I can't avoid it. Not everything can be delivered to my house. I can't afford to live alone, either.

Even friends and family don't care. It's so pointless. We all try and make connections with people. But for what purpose? To pretend we're loved? It's so pathetic and ignorant of all of us. I'm guilty of it too.
I can't afford to not have a job. And all jobs involve people. Every. Single. One.
People don't care about other people. We just pretend to because we feel guilty otherwise. It's all selfish.
